Title: Tanay and the Family

Cast

1. Tanay - 11 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Shalini - 38 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
3. Ananya - 11 years, friend
Look: pink T-shirt, ponytail

Places

1. The bedroom - a big bed, a wooden cupboard

Scene 1: The bedroom - Day

[Tanay stands in the bedroom. Shalini stands near him.]

Shalini: "Tanay, what's the plan today?"

[Tanay yawns loudly.]

Tanay (softly): "And then?"

[Tanay stretches his arms above his head.]

Shalini: "I really enjoyed today."
